Guard against averaging bounded unit-level indices

Source: R/guards.R
pollin_guard_bounded.Rd

The Relative Interaction Index and the dependence ratio are bounded ratios. The mean of per-unit (per-plant, per-plot, per-site) ratios is not the ratio of the expected values: with unequal unit means the two differ, and the mean of ratios has no causal reading as the trial's dependence. This guard refuses the average unless allow = TRUE, and when allowed it reports the average with that statement and, from a design, beside the ratio of means.

Usage

pollin_guard_bounded(x, index, allow = FALSE, response = NULL, unit = NULL)

Arguments

x

A pollin_design() with an "excluded" and an "open" arm, or a numeric vector of unit-level index values.

index

"rii" or "dependence". There is no default.

allow

FALSE (the default) stops with an error; TRUE returns the average with the warning statement attached.

response

With a design, the response column to use. It may be left NULL when the data declare one response.

unit

With a design, the unit column the arm means are taken over, one of the design's unit nesting. NULL (the default) uses the outermost unit; an inner unit is taken within its outer units.

Value

With allow = TRUE, an object of class pollin_bounded: a list holding index, n (units averaged), mean_of_units, ratio_of_means (NA for a numeric vector), per_unit (a data frame, or NULL for a numeric vector) and the note printed with it.

Details

Two inputs are accepted:

  • a pollin_design(): unit-level arm means are computed as in pollin_rii() (excluded versus open arm, outermost unit by default), the index is computed for each unit, and the ratio of means is computed from the arm means across units;

  • a numeric vector of unit-level index values already computed. The ratio of means cannot be recovered from these and is reported as NA.

The indices are rii = (open - excluded) / (open + excluded) and dependence = 1 - excluded / open, as in pollin_index().

See also

pollin_index() for the index of the arm means with an interval.

Examples

df <- data.frame(
  pods = rpois(48, rep(c(20, 30, 40, 60), each = 12)),
  trt = rep(c("Cage", "Open"), 24),
  Site = rep(letters[1:4], each = 12)
)
pd <- pollin_data(df, "pods", "trt", unit = "Site")
ds <- pollin_design(pd, c(excluded = "Cage", open = "Open"), "multi_site")
# Refused by default
try(pollin_guard_bounded(ds, index = "rii"))
#> Error : Averaging bounded per-unit ratios is not the ratio of expected values; the mean of 4 unit-level RII values is not the trial's RII. The RII of the arm means is -0.0248. Set `allow = TRUE` to average them anyway.
# Allowed, with the statement and the ratio of means beside it
pollin_guard_bounded(ds, index = "rii", allow = TRUE)
#> <pollin_bounded>  average of unit-level RII values
#>   mean of 4 units : -0.0297
#>   RII of arm means : -0.0248
#>   Averaging bounded per-unit ratios is not the ratio of expected values; the mean of 4 unit-level RII values is not the trial's RII.
